title: 第十五章 紫影归心梦绪洗白第十六章 时空异动冰川回响
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 第十五章紫影归心，梦绪洗白
暗沉天穹黑云翻涌不息，整片琉光星冕学园彻底被厚重死寂的暗影迷雾牢牢笼罩。凛冽暴戾的狂风盘旋呼啸于天地之间，卷起满地碎石残屑肆意冲撞，每一寸空气里都充斥着阴诡刺骨、杀伐滔天的暗黑灵力。
高空之上，紫苑梦绪一袭诡美冷冽的堕幻影侍战衣凌空伫立，紫调渐变的长卷发被暗黑罡风肆意扬起，发丝末端萦绕的细碎暗影幻光在昏暗天光里明明灭灭，衬得那张绝美的脸庞冰冷漠然，无半分鲜活温度。
历经方才数次人格撕裂的极致剧痛，她强行压下神魂深处翻涌不止的挣扎与混乱，再度被暗黑傀儡人格彻底掌控心神。浅紫灰色的瞳眸蒙着一层厚重凝滞的暗黑雾霭，空洞死寂、冰冷无情，唯有深入骨髓的杀伐戾气与绝对服从的机械漠然，再也寻不到半分属于夜见幽弥的温柔与鲜活。
纤细白皙的五指紧紧攥握着缠梦影鞭，鞭身繁复诡谲的暗黑纹路灵力流转不息，锋利冷冽的棱刺折射出森然刺骨的寒光。周身浩瀚磅礴的堕幻影雾层层铺展、碾压四方，无解霸道的暗影威压持续压制着下方四人的光明灵力，明暗对峙的极致张力充斥天地，让整个战场的氛围压抑到极致。
下方广场中央，天野凛星、藤咲若织、海月涟音、琉璃金朵四人稳稳伫立在稳固的四方防御战阵之中，周身光明灵力温润绵长、层层护体，始终恪守着只防不攻、温柔牵制、绝不伤人的初心约定。
天野凛星金调渐变的黑发被狂风轻轻拂动，澄澈锐利的冰蓝眼眸紧紧锁定高空那道孤冷凌厉的身影，心底的酸涩疼惜与执拗期许层层堆叠、翻涌不息。他早已清晰洞悉紫苑梦绪的真实状态，看穿她每一次凌厉攻势背后、每一次冰冷漠然之下，无人窥见、无人知晓、反复撕裂神魂、蚀骨焚心的极致痛苦与挣扎。
这位被黑暗彻底禁锢、被宿命无情裹挟的少女，从来都不是嗜血嗜杀的暗影仇敌，只是一个被谎言蒙蔽、被阴谋算计、被命运碾碎、被迫沉沦黑暗的可怜人。
“全员稳住阵型，层层叠加防御，放缓灵力输出，以柔力缓冲所有攻势，绝不主动反击，绝不造成半点伤害。”
天野凛星沉稳厚重的嗓音穿透呼啸狂风，清晰传入耳畔，字字郑重、句句恳切，持续叮嘱着身边的同伴。他身姿挺拔如松，周身冰与圣光交织的温润灵力缓缓流转，时刻准备撑起全域圣光结界，温柔承接所有暗黑攻势，护住全队周全，静待迷途少女本心松动、微光破晓。
海月涟音碧绿澄澈的眼眸盛满心疼与不忍，水风双系灵力化作万顷柔波萦绕全队，沧澜汐风温柔流转，层层叠叠的水风护盾稳稳铺开，极致柔和的水系力量时刻缓冲着高空倾泻而下的凌厉暗影冲击，最大限度削弱杀伐力道，守护着整个防御阵型的安稳。
琉璃金朵娇俏的眉眼褪去所有灵动软糯，满是认真肃穆，掌心土金双系灵力层层叠加、稳固厚重，金石壁垒扎根大地、延绵四方，细密的灵力丝线暗中交织缠绕，随时准备展开温柔禁锢、补强防御短板，全程耐心周旋、温柔牵制，始终坚守不伤害挚友的底线。
唯有藤咲若织绯霞渐变的长卷发在狂风中静静垂落，她温柔通透的眼眸始终牢牢凝望着高空那道孤寂冰冷的身影，目光温柔绵长、岁岁牵挂，若有若无地扫过少女被战衣袖口轻轻遮盖的纤细腕间。
那里，一条红紫渐变、承载万般期许与温柔救赎的羁绊手链，正静静蛰伏、无声存在。
手链之上潜藏的红莲治愈灵力温润内敛、悄然渗透，日复一日、潜移默化地滋养着紫苑梦绪饱受创伤、濒临崩碎的神魂，一点点松动着暗樱女王布下的暗黑禁锢，一点点弱化着傀儡人格的绝对掌控，一点点守护着那缕深埋神魂、从未彻底泯灭的温柔本心。
无人察觉的细微灵力联结，早已悄然架起黑暗与光明之间唯一的桥梁，沉沦与救赎之间唯一的羁绊。
高空之上的对峙依旧持续，明暗灵力的碰撞轰鸣连绵不绝、震彻天地。
紫苑梦绪面无表情、眸光冰冷，完全遵从暗樱女王植入神魂的暗黑指令，手中缠梦影鞭再度蓄力暴涨，周身暗黑灵力疯狂翻涌、层层叠加，较之先前更为霸道凌厉、更为阴诡无解的暗影力量席卷四方。
她空灵死寂、毫无波澜的清冷嗓音响彻暗沉虚空，机械刻板、字字冰冷，不带半分人间情绪。
“幻梦千影噬界。”
口令落下的刹那，整个虚空剧烈震颤、暗流狂涌！
无数道真假难辨、虚实交错的暗黑影鞭自漫天堕幻影雾之中极速凝练、丛生裂变，成千上万道凌厉刺骨的鞭影铺天盖地、四面八方全域笼罩，带着碾压一切、撕碎光明的霸道威势轰然俯冲而下。
每一道鞭影都裹挟着暗樱女王加持的深渊本源之力，招式阴诡莫测、攻势密集无解、杀伐力道滔天，彻底封锁了四人所有的闪避空间、防御死角，企图一举击溃整个光明防御阵型，彻底肃清眼前所有光明战力。
漫天暗影杀伐倾覆而来，黑云压城、万影噬界，肃杀之气笼罩天地，大战的烈度瞬间攀升至全新高度。
“水风千层沧澜盾！”
“金石万叠固元壁！”
海月涟音与琉璃金朵默契十足、同步发力，双系极致防御招式瞬间全开！
澄澈温润的水风灵力层层叠叠、交织成万顷碧波结界，柔软绵长的水流之力极致缓冲、消解冲击，将凌厉霸道的暗影攻势层层卸力、步步弱化。厚重沉稳的土金灵力扎根大地、升腾而起，万千层金石壁垒错落叠加、坚不可摧，牢牢筑牢全队防御根基，抵挡住漫天肆虐的暗黑鞭影。
双层极致防御结界完美相融、全域覆盖，温柔包容的光明力量稳稳承接住铺天盖地的暗影攻势。
剧烈的灵力碰撞轰然炸响，明暗两股极致力量疯狂对冲、剧烈震荡，漫天细碎斑斓的灵力星火四溅纷飞，如同坠落人间的星雨，在暗沉压抑的天地之间转瞬绽放、快速湮灭。
天野凛星伫立阵型最中央，周身冰圣光灵力缓缓铺开，无形的圣光净化之力悄然流转，温柔安抚着空气中暴戾躁动的暗黑戾气，同时时刻探查着高空少女的神魂波动，精准捕捉着她每一次细微的灵力紊乱、身形滞涩、眼底挣扎。
他看得无比清楚，这一记霸道无解的绝杀招式之下，紫苑梦绪的身躯依旧在不易察觉地微微震颤，灵力输出断断续续、起伏不定，眼底的暗黑幻雾反复碎裂、反复重组，神魂深处的人格拉扯从未停止、永无停歇。
暗黑傀儡人格的冰冷杀伐、绝对服从，与原始本心人格的温柔悲悯、厌恶杀戮，依旧在她残破受损的神魂之中，进行着无休止、无间断的惨烈博弈、极致撕扯。
她看似杀伐果断、冷漠无情的每一次进攻，本质上都是一场无人窥见、痛彻神魂、濒临崩碎的自我酷刑。
“稳住心神，固守结界，不必强攻，耐心周旋。”
天野凛星轻声叮嘱，嗓音温柔却坚定有力，目光始终紧锁高空，心底的决心愈发澄澈笃定。
他今日不求一战破局、不求即刻救赎，只求温柔守护、耐心等候，以全员赤诚羁绊为盾，以长久温柔坚守为光，一点点穿透厚重黑暗，一点点唤醒迷途本心，终将让迷途沉沦的挚友，挣脱枷锁、踏光而归。
就在明暗对战持续拉锯、灵力碰撞连绵不绝、战局陷入稳定周旋的刹那，无人察觉的虚空暗影深处，一缕极细极暗、隐匿无形的纯粹暗黑灵力悄然凝聚、极速凝练。
整个天地的注意力尽数被高空对战、灵力轰鸣、漫天鞭影吸引，所有人的感知都聚焦在紫苑梦绪正面的攻势之上，无人探查、无人洞悉遥远虚空暗处潜藏的致命杀机。
远在星界暗黑神殿的暗樱女王，透过跨越时空的暗黑镜像，全程清晰俯瞰着人间战场的每一处细节、每一分变化。
她冷漠阴鸷的眸光牢牢锁定着紫苑梦绪的身影，眼底翻涌着冰冷阴狠、残忍无情的戾气。
她早已精准察觉，自己强行植入的暗黑傀儡人格已然极度不稳，紫苑梦绪神魂深处残存的伊瑟拉本心正在持续复苏、反复挣扎，即便被层层封禁、死死压制，却依旧在一次次明暗对峙、一次次触碰光明羁绊的过程中，不断松动、不断苏醒、不断壮大。
那缕深埋神魂、不灭不散的温柔微光，正在悄然瓦解她的暗黑禁术、打破她的神魂禁锢、撼动她的绝对掌控。
藤咲若织悄然系上的羁绊手链、潜移默化滋养神魂的红莲灵力、守护者战队全员不离不弃的温柔包容、日复一日的羁绊浸润，都在一点点撕裂她精心编织的黑暗骗局，一点点动摇紫苑梦绪绝对臣服、永久为傀的宿命。

Chapter 15 The purple shadow returns to the heart, and the dream is washed away
The dark sky was filled with black clouds, and the entire Liuguang Xingmian Academy was completely shrouded in a thick, silent shadow mist. Biting and violent winds swirled and howled between the sky and the earth, rolling up rubble and debris all over the ground and crashing into them. Every inch of the air was filled with the dark spiritual power that was piercing and murderous.
High in the sky, Ziyuan Mengxu stood in the air wearing a beautiful and cold Fallen Phantom Warrior battle suit. Her long curly hair with gradient purple tones was blown up by the dark wind. The fine shadows lingering at the ends of her hair were clearly extinguished in the dim sky, making her beautiful face cold and indifferent, without any vitality.
After experiencing the extreme pain of having her personality torn apart several times just now, she forced down the struggle and chaos surging deep in her soul, and was once again completely controlled by the dark puppet personality. The light purple-grey pupils were covered with a thick layer of stagnant dark mist. They were hollow, dead, cold and ruthless. Only the murderous ferocity that penetrated into the bone marrow and the mechanical indifference of absolute obedience could no longer find even half of the tenderness and freshness that belonged to Yami Yuya.
The slender white fingers tightly grasped the Dream-Entering Shadow Whip. The complex and strange dark lines on the whip's body were filled with spiritual energy, and the sharp and cold thorns reflected the piercing cold light. The vast and majestic fallen phantom mist spread layer by layer around him, crushing all directions. The unexplainable and overbearing shadow pressure continued to suppress the light spiritual power of the four people below. The extreme tension of the confrontation between light and darkness filled the world, making the atmosphere of the entire battlefield extremely depressing.
In the center of the square below, four people, Amano Rinsei, Fujisaki Wakaori, Kaiyue Renyin, and Liuli Jinduo, stood firmly in a solid four-sided defense formation. The bright spiritual energy around them was warm and long, protecting their bodies in layers. They always adhered to the original promise of only defending but not attacking, gently restraining, and never hurting anyone.
Amano Rinxing's golden-toned black hair was gently tossed by the strong wind, and her clear and sharp ice-blue eyes were tightly locked on the lonely and sharp figure high in the sky. The sour love and stubborn expectations in her heart were piled up and surging. He had already clearly understood the true state of Ziyuan Mengxu, and saw through every fierce attack and cold indifference behind her, the extreme pain and struggle that no one could see or know, repeatedly tearing apart the soul, eroding the bones and burning the heart.
This girl who was completely imprisoned by darkness and ruthlessly bound by fate was never a bloodthirsty enemy of the shadows. She was just a poor person who was blinded by lies, plotted, crushed by fate, and forced to sink into the darkness.
"Everyone maintains a stable formation, stacks up layers of defense, slows down the output of spiritual power, buffers all attacks with soft power, never takes the initiative to counterattack, and never causes any damage."
Amano Rinkei's calm and thick voice penetrated the howling wind and reached his ears clearly. He continued to instruct his companions around him with solemn words and sincere sentences. His body is as tall and straight as a pine, and the warm spiritual power intertwined with ice and holy light around him slowly flows. He is always ready to hold up the holy light barrier in the entire area, gently accept all dark attacks, protect the entire team, and wait for the lost girl's heart to loosen and the dawn to break.
Haiyue Lianyin's green and clear eyes were filled with distress and unbearability. The spiritual power of the water and wind elements turned into soft waves that surrounded the entire team. The Canglan Xi wind flowed gently, and the layers of water and wind shields were steadily spread out. The extremely soft water power always buffered the sharp shadow impact pouring down from the sky, weakening the killing power to the maximum extent, and guarding the stability of the entire defensive formation.
The pretty brows of Liuli Jinduo have lost all the softness and softness, and are full of seriousness and solemnity. The spiritual power of earth and metal in the palm of the hand is layered, solid and thick. The metal and stone barriers are rooted in the earth and stretch in all directions. The fine spiritual power threads are secretly intertwined. They are always ready to launch gentle confinement and strengthen defense shortcomings. They deal patiently and gently contain the whole process, and always adhere to the bottom line of not harming their best friends.
Only Fujisaki Wakaori Hiika's long curly hair fell quietly in the strong wind. Her gentle and transparent eyes were always fixed on the lonely and cold figure high in the sky. Her eyes were gentle and long, caring for years, and they scanned the girl's slender wrist that was lightly covered by the cuffs of her battle clothes.
There, a fetter bracelet with a gradient of red and purple, carrying all kinds of expectations and gentle redemption, is quietly dormant and exists silently.
The red lotus healing spiritual power hidden on the bracelet is gentle and restrained, quietly penetrating, day after day, subtly nourishing Shion Mengxu's traumatized and on the verge of collapse, gradually loosening the dark imprisonment set by Queen Dark Sakura, gradually weakening the absolute control of the puppet's personality, and bit by bit guarding the gentle heart that is buried deep in the soul and has never been completely annihilated.
The subtle spiritual connection that no one noticed has quietly built the only bridge between darkness and light, the only bond between sinking and redemption.
The confrontation high in the sky still continued, and the collision of light and dark spiritual powers continued and roared, shaking the world.
Ziyuan Mengxu's face was expressionless and her eyes were cold. She completely obeyed the dark instructions implanted in the soul of the Queen of Dark Sakura. The power of the Dream Shadow Whip in her hand increased sharply again. The dark spiritual power around her body surged crazily and was superimposed layer by layer. The shadow power that was more domineering and cunning than before swept across all directions.
Her ethereal, lifeless, cold voice echoed through the dark void. Her words were mechanical and rigid, and her words were cold and devoid of any human emotions.
"Thousands of Phantom Dreams Devour the Realm."
The moment the password fell, the entire void trembled violently and undercurrents surged!
Countless dark shadow whips that are hard to distinguish between true and false, intertwined with reality, condense and fission rapidly from the phantom mist that fills the sky. Thousands of sharp and piercing whip shadows cover the sky and cover the entire area in all directions, swooping down with a domineering power that crushes everything and tears apart the light.
Each whip shadow is wrapped with the power of the abyss blessed by the Queen of Dark Sakura. The moves are unpredictable, the attack is intensive and the killing power is overwhelming. It completely blocks all the dodge space and defensive blind spots of the four people, trying to defeat the entire light defense formation in one fell swoop and completely eliminate all the light combat power in front of them.
The sky was full of shadows and killings, black clouds pressed down on the city, thousands of shadows engulfed the world, and a chilling atmosphere enveloped the world. The intensity of the battle instantly rose to a new level.
"Shui Feng Thousand Layers of Canglan Shield!"
"Ten thousand layers of gold and stone solidify the wall!"
Haiyue Lianyin and Liuli Jinduo have a perfect tacit understanding and synchronize their power, and the ultimate defensive moves of both systems are fully activated in an instant!
The clear and gentle water and wind spiritual power are layered and intertwined into a barrier of vast expanse of blue waves. The power of the soft and long water flow can extremely buffer and dissipate the impact, unloading and weakening the fierce and domineering shadow offensive step by step. The thick and steady spiritual power of earth and metal takes root in the earth and rises into the sky. Thousands of layers of metal and stone barriers are stacked at random and are indestructible. They firmly build the team's defense foundation and resist the dark whip shadow that is raging all over the sky.
The double-layered ultimate defensive barrier is perfectly integrated and covers the whole area. The gentle and tolerant light power can steadily withstand the overwhelming shadow offensive.
The violent collision of spiritual power exploded, and the two extreme forces of light and dark clashed wildly and vibrated violently. The tiny and colorful spiritual power sparks scattered all over the sky, like a rain of stars falling into the world, blooming in an instant and annihilating quickly in the dark and oppressive world.
Amano Rinxei stood in the center of the formation, the spiritual power of the ice holy light spread out slowly around him, and the invisible purifying power of the holy light flowed quietly, gently soothing the violent and restless dark energy in the air. At the same time, he constantly probed the fluctuations of the girl's soul in the sky, and accurately captured every subtle disorder of her spiritual power, stagnant figure, and struggles in her eyes.
He could see extremely clearly that under this overbearing and incomprehensible killing move, Shion Mengxu's body was still trembling slightly and unnoticeably. The output of spiritual power was intermittent and fluctuating. The dark phantom mist in his eyes repeatedly shattered and reorganized. The pull of human beings deep in his soul never stopped or stopped.
The cold killing and absolute obedience of the dark puppet personality, and the gentle compassion and aversion to killing of the original personality are still engaged in an endless and uninterrupted fierce game and extreme tearing in her broken and damaged soul.
Every attack she made that seemed decisive, cold and ruthless was actually a form of self-torture that no one could see, painful to the soul, and on the verge of collapse.
"Steady your mind, stick to the barrier, don't attack forcefully, be patient."
Amano Rinxei whispered softly, his voice was gentle but firm and powerful, his eyes were always fixed on the sky, and the determination in his heart became clearer and more determined.
Today, he does not ask for a battle to break the situation, nor for immediate redemption, but for gentle protection and patient waiting. With the sincerity of all members as a shield, and long-term gentle persistence as light, he will penetrate the thick darkness bit by bit, awaken the lost heart bit by bit, and finally let the lost and sunken best friends break free from the shackles and return in the light.
At the moment when the battle between light and darkness continued, the collision of spiritual powers continued, and the battle situation fell into a stable situation, deep in the shadow of the void that no one noticed, a thin, extremely dark, invisible ray of pure dark spiritual power quietly condensed and condensed at an extremely rapid rate.
The entire world's attention was attracted by the high-altitude battle, the roar of spiritual power, and the whip shadows all over the sky. Everyone's perception was focused on Shion Mengxu's frontal offensive. No one was exploring or understanding the deadly murderous intention lurking in the darkness of the distant void.
The Queen of Dark Sakura, who is far away in the Dark Temple of the Star Boundary, clearly overlooks every detail and every change of the human battlefield through the dark mirror that spans time and space.
Her cold and sinister eyes were firmly locked on the figure of Shion Mengxu, and her eyes were filled with cold, vicious, cruel and ruthless anger.
She had already accurately noticed that the personality of the dark puppet she had forcibly implanted was extremely unstable. The remaining Ysela's original heart deep in Ziyuan Mengxu's soul was continuing to revive and struggle repeatedly. Even though it was banned and suppressed at all levels, it was still loosening, awakening, and growing in the process of confrontation between light and dark and touching the fetters of light again and again.
That gentle glimmer of light that was buried deep in her soul and would never fade away was quietly disintegrating her dark forbidden arts, breaking the confinement of her soul, and shaking her absolute control.
The bond bracelet that Fujisaki Wakaori quietly tied on, the red lotus spiritual power that subtly nourishes the soul, the unyielding gentleness and tolerance of all members of the Guardian team, and the daily infiltration of bonds, are all tearing apart the dark deception she carefully weaved, and shaking Shion Yumeo's absolute surrender and the fate of being a puppet forever.
title_en: Chapter 15 Purple Shadow Returns to Heart and Dreams Whiten Chapter 16 Time and Space Changes and Glacier Echoes
